book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel Moalamangnindna Andra, Yesusna Nemelmom Hoanavho Vrulangalm.

content: Pita Moamba Velokusathinna Kristusnindna Kuwulmba.
Vena, moalamangnind eva Yutanindna Kristusnind diva Yutia provinsrava hillinamba, osva Yutanindna meisnindva doa eva saivnata Sesoana besal nemelmoravata.
Heva os nonamba Pitava provnamba Yerusalemramba, nomba monglava Yutanindna Kristusnindva os waialhuna hemba.
Hev umnina, yimba vesiha vinvna deuvrava no Yutanindna meisnindina, eva henamba hutovpa kueinnamoa owai, wo eva yimba wonnevna hemba innemba mongawulmba.
Pitava temura wohishunvna hemba.

Hev unna, kava mendah di avna Yopa kotara. Nonamba kava sembayang vevna, wo kava mana emam nongla inungpunungmsna. No inungpunungrava kava nonglana, mana vemava mendekli kayenna nihna holvopevna senakembellini. Kihpevna petharam. Di hevm murapeta kainda wohholvopena,
wo kava nov vesiha vena. Wo kava nongalna tatam, sungeittatam, boangalm eva tuawam.
Wo kava hellevna, ishomnavna moalamangva kam, pho Pita, miklewol verava, wena veo.
Wo kava ophona, owai mendekli, kava doarava doava nenamoa snamba mana vemava sahoklalva, temba nomba yimba doara kamba Yutanindmba lohohsama kelathinna, hlalmba.
Wo no moalamang henga opla vramnana kam senaminim, Sesoa henga vewol vena manimani honamba besal. Manam osva hengava nengsmoa ovra, sahoklal, yimba.
Honamba osva samblamongolm vawomnana. Wo nomba mana vemava henga os hoai vena senakembellam.
Wo doa henanam samblamong indhana ambna deuvram, di kam waiaevvnam. Hemba wolamb vena kaindamba Sisaria kotarini.

Wo Sesoasongol kamba omnana, wongao, manam yimba sah owol vevav monarava. Wo honamba Kristusnindmba 6pelarava, memba kava wonamana vilproiva, hemba kava nihra wongana. Kav wongana Koniliusna deuvramangas.
Himba ishunvna kamba nom, ovsongolnindrini lohmanavna hena deuvmora. Wo no ovsongolnindrini omnana hem, wolanga veo monglam indhanam Yoparam, omnahalvolm Simon Pitam hom.
He si yemba ishunvav. Nomba manam manam himba si yemba ishunvavpa, si yem eva pevna ungevlitundism lopshavav.
Kava nonamba kavna moamba osingthavnamba, Sesoasongolva os prunna heindamba, os piindam ten nemet prunnam.
Wo kava henga nengvhoana moamba mendeklinamba. Hev ona, Yonmba pona poswol vena, heva os Sesoasongolva yemba si awothowol vevav.

Nemetva pivva undnahonamba amnavna mendekli Yesus Kristusmba, wo Sesoava daswolvna hevsongolva ambo nis pimba. Wo doa Sesoava eva daswolvta honamba mongawatovna hemba, os ten pim vinnam. Wo es hevpa, an kava, wo kava ollavavma Sesoana andramba? Owai.

Nonamba nomba Yutanindna Kristusnindva hillivnamba honamba, doa himba os sesavethana. Himba Sesoam okulivnamba, uvna, doa Sesoava wolasiha vena Yutanindna meisnindmba evata, weihaloh vewolalm, amnalm hem, wo himba si yunalm wohavav.
Besal Nemelmomba Phunna Antioknindm.

Nonamba Stevenmba helvakomandhinamba, indkumbimba Kristusnindmba eva indkokla vewol vivnata sahonam. Monglava pem bukethungu vevna os Ponisia provinsram, Saiprus wan kuvundthollam, eva Antiok kotaram. Wo himba di nomba Yutanindmba numhowol vewuvna besal nemelmonamba, Yutanindna meisungundmba owai.
Heva os monglava no Kristusnindva himba Saiprusnind eva Sairini kotanind. Nonamba himba pulvonamba Antiokrava, himba eishunvna osoa eva Yutanindna meisungundmba besal nemelmomba mendekli Yesusnamba.
Wo nonamba mendekli hev koldombvna hemba. Wo indkumbiva vinamba, keknam undnahonam avna, wo weihaloh avramana vena hevmba mendekliindam.
Wo Kristusnindva Yerusalemrava os helamb vena honamba os, wo himba vinamba, wuleihingivna Barnapasmba Antiokramba.

Barnapasva besal indhanarini lohvna Sesoasongolnana, eva keknam undnahonam wohlohvna. Nonamba himba phovnamba Antiokrava, wo nongalv, osva ona, os Sesoava awothowol vena hemba, wo himba und kanandhana. Wo himba henga hena nengavnangmba tuhowol ovunna Antiokrava. Hev unna, yimba manam kivrawuliha vrivra, almba undnahonamba keknamba. Elsus wohengivm mendeklimoa pevna undnahonam. Nonamba indhanamba mindnam pelpethavna mendeklitindilmba.
Wo Barnapasva os gana Tarsus kotaramba, silelalmba Solmba.

Nonamba himba Solmba pethanamba, himba os waiprona Antiokramba. Wo no mongawa osonam Barnapasiva Soliva wonahana no Kristusnindmba. Himba diva indhanamba mindnam numhowol avahana. Diva Antiokrava Yesustindimba seilva os nengsmoa uvna, Kristusnind.
Wo nonamba monglava moashulnindva pepra vena Yerusalemrini Antiokramba.

Mongova heriniva, nihilva henamba Akapus. Hev phonamba, ishunvna Sesoasongolnana. Hev unna, doa prov mendekliva owousva vavawonam petharamba. Si innemba indhanamba asahvav, hlalmba. Memba nonam owousva nongalphona, Klotius Sisa king kuwulalm lohvnam.

Nonamba Yesustindiva ningvnamba, kolvrowolalmba Kristusnindmba owalmba, nomba temba aevulvnamba Yutia provinsrava. Himba indakonda ningwul vevna, os himba nomba heva hevna nengavnangna, dembhanga vinilm.
Doa hev di wulkusonamba, dembroh vinvna Barnapasim Solim, osm he si ahai engavav no Kristusnindna kuwulindamba Yutia provinsramba.
